title: Can AI move beyond prediction and play a larger role in market participation?
author: Sure_Sandwich5618
selftext: I have been noticing that a lot of AI systems in trading are used primarily for forecasting, signal generation, or risk analysis. What interests me is whether AI could eventually play a more active role in how prediction-based systems operate, especially in situations where participation is limited or market activity is uneven. As models become better at processing information and updating probabilities in real time, it seems like the line between prediction and participation could become less clear. Do you think AI will remain mostly a forecasting tool, or could it eventually become a more active component of how these systems function?

comments.author: The_AI_Trader
comments.body: 100% AI can be deployed in these instances . I’ve seen it hands on it’s ability to understand certain markets. Having said that, based on the infrastructure, it may have advantages with certain markets and trouble with others.
